tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows a saturating response to u_now, but its fixed gradient and state leave the source of saturation unidentified. The open-branch probe can distinguish the plausible mechanisms.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All pilot rows fix x_now and s_grad, so they cannot distinguish recruitment from a mobility-bridge mechanism with similar saturation.
The ambiguity concerns the open mechanism branch rather than temporal resolution; the discriminating probe costs less.
It is not relevant to identifying the mechanism.
